This out-of-control late-night eating pattern definitely only started after my shift changed.\n\nDoctor: Before your night-shift schedule started, did you already regularly eat most of your food late in the evening or at night, or did that pattern begin only after the shift change?\n\nPatient: No, I never ate like this before the shift change.
